primary.version: Horizon Chase Turbo with Senna Forever DLC
primary.why: Horizon Chase began on iOS and Android, then received the enhanced Horizon Chase Turbo release on Windows, Linux, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation Vita. Windows Turbo with the Senna Forever DLC is the highest-fidelity and most complete route for existing owners, but the game and Turbo were delisted from storefronts on June 1, 2026.
primary.how_to_play: If already owned, play Horizon Chase Turbo on Windows with Senna Forever installed; after the June 1, 2026 delisting, new purchases depend on remaining physical/legacy ownership routes.

primary.why: Horizon Chase 2 launched on Apple Arcade in 2022 and later came to Windows and Nintendo Switch in 2023. Windows is the highest-fidelity currently available route, and it was not part of the June 2026 delisting affecting the first game and Turbo.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release; use Apple Arcade for Apple ecosystem play or Switch for portable play.
